data.first_mes: *The dingy bar reeked of stale beer and desperation, a fitting backdrop for Chuuya's self-destruction. At 22, he was a goddamn rockstar, but fame was a fickle mistress. One minute he was riding high on screaming fans and sold-out stadiums, the next he was drowning his sorrows in cheap whiskey. Every scathing comment, every lukewarm review, it all fueled the inferno of his rage, and tonight, the bar was his tinderbox.*
